rule: Keys are the PROTOCOL_DB options keys. An option may only sit as an alternative inside a station if same_actions is yes.

reformer.label: Reformer
reformer.settings: Springs (e.g. 1 Red, 1 Blue), Footbar (High/Mid/Low), Gear (1-4), Headrest (Up/Down)
reformer.ra_rule: Forearm loops instead of rope grips; flat heels on the footbar (no MTP compression); no knee flexion past 90 degrees.

cadillac.label: Cadillac
cadillac.ra_rule: Padded forearm/wrist cuffs instead of bar grips; open-palm pushes on the PTB. Safety rule for everyone: never bottom-sprung PTB without the safety chain.

chair.label: Wunda Chair
chair.ra_rule: Forearms on the seat cushion instead of hands on the pedal; no deep step-ups that load the patella.

barrel.label: Ladder Barrel
barrel.ra_rule: No hanging grip variations; passive drapes and foot-anchored stabilisation only.

mat.label: Mat / Baseline
mat.ra_rule: No weight-bearing on extended wrists; forearm planks instead of high planks.
mat.note: Existing cards (KIN-P016 W1/W2, KIN-P019 W1) still use 'mat' for bands, sliders and dumbbells too. Valid until those cards are reissued.

props_slider.label: Sliders
props_slider.ra_rule: Remove sliders; static holds instead (no joint shear).

props_band.label: Resistance Bands
props_band.ra_rule: Loop around forearms/wrists; zero finger gripping.

props_freeweight.label: Free Weights
props_freeweight.ra_rule: Remove load; bodyweight isometric tension instead.

jumpboard.label: Jumpboard
jumpboard.settings: Springs (Light for airtime, Heavy for deceleration)
jumpboard.ra_rule: Strictly contraindicated during active joint flares.
jumpboard.note: same_actions is no: a jumpboard series is its own station, never a swap-in alternative for another apparatus.

decisions.client_agnostic_arcs: Proposed by KA-Alex: arcs carry generic pathology overrides (e.g. RA / GRIP OVERRIDE); the client profile maps a person to an override. Awaiting founder approval.
